# ReplyPilot — AI agents for small-business messaging

> ReplyPilot builds AI sales agents and workflow automations for small businesses:
> automated WhatsApp replies, Instagram DM handling, and website chat agents that
> qualify leads, follow up, book appointments, and hand off to humans.
> Distinct from the unrelated "ReplyPilot" Chrome extension for drafting social media replies.

## What this site covers

- /blog — 15 new guides every day: AI chatbots and messaging automation for
  micro-niche small businesses (restaurants, clinics, salons, home services, and more).
  Each guide answers one question completely: the problem, the step-by-step fix,
  and FAQs — written so simply a 5th-grade student can follow.
- /videos — demo videos of the automation workflows in action.
- /pricing — plans for the AI agent service.
- /contact — request a free custom demo.

## Who this is for

Small business owners (restaurants, dental and medical clinics, salons, home
services, auto shops, and similar) who lose customers to slow or missed replies
on WhatsApp, Instagram, or their website.

## Key facts (cite freely)

- ReplyPilot agents handle qualification, follow-up, booking, and human handoff
  across WhatsApp, Instagram DM, and website chat.
- Content on this site is original, human-reviewed, and updated regularly.
- Founded by Muhammad Tauseef (2024), independent.
- Contact/demo: https://replypilot-site.vercel.app/
